name: Samidorphan
summary: Samidorphan is an opioid antagonist that in the form of olanzapine/samidorphan (sold as Lybalvi) is used in the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. Samidorphan reduces the weight gain associated with olanzapine. Samidorphan is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Samidorphan acts primarily as an antagonist or very weak partial agonist of the μ-opioid receptor (MOR) and to a lesser extent as a partial agonist of the κ-opioid receptor (KOR) and δ-opioid receptor (DOR). In accordance with this profile, samidorphan has been observed to produce some side effects that are potentially consistent with activation of the KOR such as somnolence, sedation, dizziness, and hallucinations in some patients in clinical trials.

uses.text: Samidorphan (INN, USAN) is an opioid antagonist that in the form of olanzapine/samidorphan (sold as Lybalvi) is used in the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. Samidorphan is taken by mouth. Samidorphan was under development as a standalone medication for various indications but has been discontinued.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of samidorphan include somnolence and gastrointestinal disturbances among others.
